generation.operation: New card generation using designated originals as layout and style references
generation.promptFileTrailingNewline: Saved file has one terminal newline; call prompt otherwise identical

references.role: Authoritative original card-face layout: parchment, title ribbon, black Cyrillic serif, purple medallion, exactly four vertical gold coins and original relative scales
Original painted atmospheric medieval architecture and twilight sky only; not its telescope, dome, alley, moon, composition or text
Original painterly stone construction and substantial readable architectural masses only; not fortress composition, battlements, red medallion, five coins or title

visualChecks.method: Direct visual inspection of generated result and saved PNG via view_image; exact text manually read word by word, not OCR

purpleMedallion.observed: Gold rim, deep purple field, pink ornamental emblem

wholeCard.observed: Complete rectangular full-face image with all four coins, entire roof and tower, readable parchment ability and full separate lower ribbon; no mockup or external padding

scene.observed: Tall slender weathered stone tower, steep slate roof and smaller attached turrets, arched lit windows, visible rocky base, blue-violet twilight with warm horizon and river valley. Tower is composition centre; no portrait, telescope, portal or floating cards

paintedAtmosphere.observed: Soft painted stone and landscape, legible architectural masses, restrained golden window glow, cool blue-violet sky; not mostly black

noExtraReadableText.observed: Only approved title and ability are readable

limitations: Manual visual text and coin verification; no OCR performed.
Generative interpretation adds a distant river, bridge and town; detail in the valley is richer than a minimal landscape but the tower remains dominant.
Final size, title baseline, lower margin and JPEG weight are deferred until artistic approval.
No numeric color or brushwork match to originals is claimed.
